resume.summary: Senior AI Engineer (PhD) with 6+ years building production-grade GenAI and agentic systems. Expert in RAG, LLM orchestration (LangGraph, Google ADK, LangChain), MCP, and prompt engineering over vector databases, deployed on GCP Vertex AI and AWS Bedrock/SageMaker with LLMOps evaluation (Ragas, LangFuse) and guardrails. Builds cloud-native Python/FastAPI microservices and translates business requirements into scalable AI products.

bullets: Architected and delivered production-grade machine learning systems using a multi-agent AI platform (**LangChain**, **LangGraph, Python, FastAPI, MCP**) for Smart Project Management, increasing business efficiency by 70%.

Led the end-to-end deployment of AI services on **GCP**, establishing rigorous system evaluation benchmarks to monitor performance across 3,000+ daily agent runs, ensuring high availability and 99% uptime.

Hardened multi-agent workflows for production reliability with tool-validation layer (**Pydantic** schema + business-rule checks), agent guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approval gates for high-stakes actions cutting task failure rate by 60%.
Instrumented observability via **LangFuse** tracing and **Ragas** evaluation, lifting evaluation scores by 75%.

Developed complex multi-agent solutions with multimodal **RAG** pipelines over massive text, image, and CAD datasets (10M+ vectors in **Pinecone**) using hybrid search and cross encoder reranking, achieving retrieval accuracy (recall@k) of 92% while holding retrieval latency (TTFT) under 600 ms.
Reduced document ingestion latency by 60% and enabled horizontal scaling by designing a distributed, event-driven ETL pipeline using **PySpark**, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, and Airflow.
Implemented scalable backend architectures using RESTful API (**FastAPI**), data validation using **Pydantic**, asynchronous system design using **asyncio**, increasing concurrency by 40%.
Improved reliable code development and reduced testing time by 40% by planning vigorous testing using **PyTest**.

Planned and implemented custom 3D Computer Vision solutions for neurological disorder analysis (**PyTorch**, Python, **OpenCV**), improving diagnosis speed by 40% and achieving 88.68% accuracy on clinical scans.
Optimized deep learning models with **ONNX**, tracked experiments with **Weights & Biases**, and deployed via **Docker** on **AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, IAM)**.

Developed and optimized a computer vision pipeline for Vulnerable Road User (VRU) detection by fine-tuning **YOLO**v3 on large-scale annotated datasets, attaining detection mAP50 of 83% at real-time inference speeds.
Built automated quality assurance (QA) and evaluation frameworks using Python, **OpenCV**, NumPy, improving annotation throughput by 20% and data quality by 25%.
Maintained high-availability backend systems (Java, MySQL) for TCS's internal website, serving 100,000+ users; streamlined the feature release cycle, reducing deployment time by 20%.
